ref.note: The business-parks phrase is grounded in a second document: programme 18.098 is not in annexe 4 (bud35) but in annexe 3, wal-aju-2026-ep-territoire-mobilite (bud34), PDF p. 53-56; objective, PDF p. 55: 'la Région wallonne mène également une politique d'accueil pour les entreprises qui désirent s'installer dans les parcs d'activités économiques reconnus. A cet effet, elle subventionne les aménagements et les infrastructures à construire à l'intérieur de ces parcs, les voiries, l'évacuation des eaux usées et pluviales [...]'. A reform ('Stratégie ZAE 2050', PDF p. 56) is pending; the 2026 credits are set at unchanged rules, and part of 18.098 is a fixed annual charge for past alternative financing (DF 098.009). Loans, guarantees and equity stakes are channelled through the regional economic tool group (Wallonie Entreprendre); much of that is financial transactions rather than grants, and programme 18.097 also funds the group's running costs, Wallimage and SPAQuE. Investment grants and research subsidies are multi-year: payments in a given year largely follow decisions already taken, so a change mostly affects new files. Also includes Digital Wallonia (18.115), EU structural-fund co-financing (18.100) and the research fund (18.118). corrected: quotes and pages confirmed in bud35. Point 3: business parks are not in bud35, but programme 18.098 is detailed in bud34 (PDF p. 53-56) with an explicit objective (subsidising roads, drainage and other infrastructure inside recognised business parks), so the phrase is kept, reworded from 'fewer new business parks developed' to 'less money to equip business parks' to match what the credits pay; locator and caveat now cite bud34 with pages. FR phrases 1 and 3 shortened. Kept four phrases: each is a separate programme of comparable size.
